name: Setup A: VWAP & EMA Breakout (VWAP BO)
desc: Consolidates above 20 & 50 EMA near VWAP; 5m breakout candle with Vol >= 3x prev bar, 10 EMA > 20 EMA > 50 EMA stack. Hard stop below 20 EMA or breakout candle low. Min 1:2 R:R.

name: Setup B: 5-Minute Volume Surge & EMA Continuation
desc: Scanner Vol >= 5x 20-SMA, ADR >= 4%, price well above rising 50 EMA. Never chase spike; wait for mean-reversion pull to 10/20 EMA. Bullish rejection wick. Stop below 50 EMA/swing low. Risk capped at ₹2,500.

name: Setup C: The EMA & VWAP Pullback Reversal
desc: Price surges, then pulls back to rising 10/20 EMA or VWAP on low volume. Rejection wick or inside bar breakout confirming 20 EMA support. Stop below 50 EMA/pullback low. Max 2 trades/day.

name: 1m Pullback to 9EMA
desc: Trend continuation on 9EMA pullback with volume contraction

name: Opening Range Breakout (ORB)
desc: Break of 09:15-09:30 range high/low with volume expansion
